Looking at this qlang language for the first time, I'll work through each task systematically, using the patterns shown in the documentation.

Let me trace through the key patterns:
- `|` pipes values through steps
- `*` applies operations to each element
- `filter ~(...)` uses quotes for conditions
- `at` reads softly (returns null if missing)
- `entries` converts maps to `[key, value]` arrays
- `groupBy * count` groups and counts values

Here are my queries:

T1: `/data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count`

T2: `/data/users | filter ~(any /roles ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name`

T3: `/data/users * (at /profile | at /country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy * count`

T4: `/data/users | filter ~(at /profile | at /age | ne null) * (/profile | /age) | avg | round 2`

T5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (/labels | * /name) | flat | * lower | distinct`

T6: `sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at /assignee | at /login)}`

T7: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at /assignee | at /login) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy * count`

T8: `[(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | tag ::map | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword | append "@" | append /1) | sort`

T9: `/services | filter ~(allOf (/enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) * /name | * lower | sort | join ","`

T10: `split "\n" | * (split " " | [/1 /2]) | filter ~(/0 | eq "ERROR") | * /1 | groupBy * count`

T11: `split "\n" | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | * (drop 3 | parseJson)) | flat | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 1`

T12: `lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:id /0 :customer /1 :product /2 :qty (/3 | parseJson) :price (/4 | parseJson) :status /5}) | filter ~(allOf (/status | lower | eq "shipped") (/price | ne null)) | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2`

T13: `lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:customer /1 :spend (mul (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) :status /5}) | filter ~(allOf (/status | lower | ne "cancelled") (/spend | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* /spend | sum) | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc)]) | take 2 * {:customer /0 :total (round /1 2)}`

T14: `["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"`
